verdicts.why: X2 plot: Mystique drugs guard Laurio and injects him with iron, which Magneto pulls out to escape; at Alkali Lake Magneto reconfigures Cerebro, Mystique as Stryker has Jason target humans, and they take Stryker's helicopter. Kind and cards fit.
X2 plot: on the flight to the base Magneto taunts Rogue about the white streaks in her hair, reminding her he almost killed her.
X2 plot: Magneto needs Jean to read Nightcrawler's mind for the base location; Jean joins Magneto and Mystique to keep an eye on them and holds off Cyclops to buy Magneto time to reach Cerebro.
Cyclops page: the brainwashed Scott prepares to shoot Magneto and Mystique from a crossing hallway; Jean shoves them clear and tells them to go, and Magneto leaves her to it.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot#6
value.text: After Daisy frees her from Ramon in Baltimore, the two erase every record of Yo-Yo's trip from S.H.I.E.L.D.'s system. Yo-Yo tells Daisy she did not kill Ramon and gives her Peggy Carter's old pin as a reminder that she is part of the team.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Inhuman who keeps Daisy's secret and gives her Peggy Carter's pin.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Inhuman who saves Yo-Yo in Baltimore and helps erase her trip.

verdicts.why: Justicia: in the present they delete all record of Yo-Yo in Baltimore from Mace's office, and she tells Daisy she did not kill Ramon and gives her Peggy's badge; Deal Breaker: Quake frees her. Nothing in #6 shows Yo-Yo 'backing her story', so that clause is dropped.
Progress: Simmons checks Yo-Yo's pulse while completing her registration; Yo-Yo knocks over equipment and suggests apartment hunting to keep them from seeing the facial-recognition search for Ramon.

Progress: Fitz upgrades Yo-Yo's watch, chastises her for getting Simmons obsessed with an apartment and says the watch lets S.H.I.E.L.D. monitor her powers; after he leaves she finds Ramon in Baltimore.
Reunion: May takes back the lanyard, warns her about sloppy spy work, promises not to tell S.H.I.E.L.D., and the pilot says he is taking her to Baltimore; May grins and nods.

Vendetta: in the flashback Coulson enters with his belongings after Mace's appointment, advises Yo-Yo to give Mace a chance and gifts her Peggy Carter's pin so she remembers she is part of a team; both hope he finds Daisy.
Cosmo page: Cosmo, with the other inhabitants of Knowhere, helps Mantis and Drax decorate for the party Mantis throws to cheer up Quill. Weak but a real act for her in a shared scene.
Cosmo page: Cosmo helps decorate Knowhere to cheer up Quill and is at the party; she acts for him in the reveal scene.
Groot and Drax pages: during the celebration Groot gives Drax a wood carving of him flipping the police car, making him laugh.
Mantis tells Drax she wants to give Quill a Christmas gift; Drax suggests Kevin Bacon and they take the Bowie to Earth and kidnap him.
Drax page: Drax notices Quill acting strange and Kraglin explains Christmas is coming, a holiday Yondu ruined for Quill.
Kraglin and Mantis pages: Kraglin tells the story to Mantis, Drax and Nebula together in the opening scene, and both are at the party reveal. A small-group scene together, which the brief counts.
Drax page: Drax suggests and helps kidnap Bacon as Quill's present; at the reveal Quill is horrified and Drax insists Bacon is great.
Rocket and Drax pages: both are in the reveal scene, each defending the kidnapped Bacon to Quill, and in the gift exchange and group hug. A team scene together, not a battle crowd; text is true.
Nebula page: Groot gives Nebula a gift, a wood carving of her watching Quill open his present.
Groot and Star-Lord pages: Groot wheels out the present, Quill calls him out for claiming it was a bad idea, Quill gives Groot a GameBoy and Groot gives him a carving of the kidnapping.
Kraglin and Nebula pages: Kraglin says Christmas is coming per the Multi-Calendar, Nebula says they have no time while rebuilding Knowhere, and the two return to repairs.

Kraglin page and Star-Lord page (Bowie): animated flashback of young Quill and Kraglin making a tree; Quill orders Kraglin to take Bacon home in the Bowie, and Kraglin tells Bacon how he inspired Quill.
Kraglin and Rocket pages: both are fellow Guardians in the party reveal, gift exchange and group hug on Knowhere. Shared team scene, text true.
Yondu page: Yondu walks in on Quill and Kraglin decorating a homemade tree, kicks it away and threatens them with latrine duty. A real flashback, not a vision.
Nebula page: as Mantis talks of cheering Quill with Christmas, Nebula says they have no time for trivialities; later she helps Mantis set up and decorate Knowhere.
Star-Lord and Rocket pages: Quill tells Mantis the kidnapping is human trafficking and Rocket says the best present for the man with everything is a human being; Mantis also has Rocket dress up.
Nebula page: Nebula lifts the lever that turns on the Christmas lights; when Bacon runs, Quill tells Nebula to get him and not kill him.
Nebula page: during the celebration Nebula drops Barnes' wrapped arm at Rocket's feet; 'Bucky's arm?' 'Merry Christmas.'
Rocket page: Rocket says the best present for the man with everything is a human being, then tries to calm the panicking Bacon.
Groot page: Groot gives Mantis a carving of her listening to Kraglin; Mantis also gets Groot ready for the celebration.
Groot page: Groot gives Kraglin a carving of him opening that same present; quote: 'Oh, Groot? He's just a kid.' (Kraglin to Bacon).

cosmo|peter-quill.text: Cosmo is one of the team on Knowhere who decorate the base and throw Quill a surprise Christmas party.
cosmo|peter-quill.on_a_card_about_b: The Guardians' leader, whose surprise Christmas party Cosmo helps decorate.
cosmo|peter-quill.on_b_card_about_a: A new member of the team who helps decorate for Quill's Christmas party.

drax|nebula.text: Drax and Nebula hear Kraglin's story of Quill's ruined Christmas together, and both are there when the team surprises Quill with a Christmas party on Knowhere.
drax|nebula.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Guardian at Quill's Christmas party on Knowhere.
drax|nebula.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian at Quill's Christmas party on Knowhere.

drax|rocket.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Guardian at Quill's Christmas party.
drax|rocket.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian at Quill's Christmas party.

kraglin|rocket.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian at Quill's Christmas party on Knowhere.

cosmo|mantis.text: Cosmo helps the people of Knowhere decorate for the surprise Christmas party that Mantis throws for Quill.
cosmo|mantis.on_a_card_about_b: A Guardian whose Christmas party for Quill Cosmo helps decorate.
cosmo|mantis.on_b_card_about_a: A new teammate who helps decorate for her Christmas party for Quill.

verdicts.why: The rules count a scene together as dealing with each other; these are teammates in small-team scenes (the opening talk for Drax and Nebula, acts for Mantis or Quill for Cosmo, the reveal, gift exchange and group hug), not a battle crowd. Keep the proposed stages as confirmed in items 9, 10, 14, 16 and 21.
Selvig page: at Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S. Selvig tells Fury 'The Tesseract is misbehaving'; Loki arrives through it and enthralls Selvig while Fury is there.
Selvig page: in the ending Selvig greets his friend Thor and gives him the Tesseract to take to Asgard; Thor touches his shoulder before leaving.
J.A.R.V.I.S. page: J.A.R.V.I.S. helps Tony through the Battle of New York and, as Tony redirects the nuke into the portal, suggests calling Potts, which Tony agrees to.
Sitwell page: on the Helicarrier Sitwell locates Loki and answers Coulson's 'Location?' with 'Stuttgart, Germany.'
